name: python-task-queue
title: Python SQLite task queue
blurb: A SQLite job queue whose delivery guarantee is written down and tested: one atomic claim per job, leases that expire, retry with capped backoff, and a dead-letter state instead of silent deletion
default_description: SQLite-backed job queue with leases, capped retries and a dead-letter state.
